artifacts.summary: 15-phase plan (14 core + 1 optional) building FormalSystem/StarLanguage/ and landing the characterization theorem for the deterministic task frames: the biconditional bridge lemma, L-star store/recall semantics, app:deterministic-future in both halves, the F0/F1 discrimination footnote, Theorem C's Det-pm half, and the forward-determinism separation via F^N.

memory_candidates.content: BimodalLogic adds a new object language as a self-contained component, now instantiated three times (MinusLanguage/L-minus, PlusLanguage/L-plus, StarLanguage/L-star). The pattern: (1) a SEPARATE inductive mirroring the base language constructor-for-constructor, never new constructors on the existing type -- adding constructors breaks downstream licensing facts such as stab_state_only, on which the atomization/conservativity route rests; (2) a constructor-to-constructor embedding (ofFormula/ofPlus) whose derived operators reuse the base language's right-hand sides verbatim, so commutation holds by rfl; (3) a DIRECTIONAL module invariant -- nothing under the language directory imports Semantics/, checkable by one grep -- with semantics living on the far side of that edge in Semantics/{Lang}Truth.lean, {Lang}Validity.lean; (4) a component aggregator FormalSystem/{Lang}Language.lean plus a line in FormalSystem/FormalSystem.lean, required by invariant C24 (every module must transitively import FormalSystem.Init). New def/abbrev names must be camelCase (invariant C26 rejects underscores in def names; theorem names stay snake_case), and any new paper \label cited in a docstring needs a KNOWN-ANCHORS row in specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md or invariant C15 fails.
